reachability_tests.test_method: crawl4ai Docker at localhost:11235 + direct Node.js HTTPS GET

crawl4ai_results.label: nba-mavs-news
crawl4ai_results.content_quality: GOOD - Full news listing with article headlines, images, and links visible in markdown

crawl4ai_results.label: mavs-com-redirect
crawl4ai_results.verdict: SKIP - 301 redirect, use destination URL directly

crawl4ai_results.label: espn-mavs
crawl4ai_results.content_quality: BLOCKED - ESPN bot detection returns 202 with empty page
crawl4ai_results.verdict: NOT RECOMMENDED - Bot detection prevents useful content extraction
crawl4ai_results.issues: ESPN serves 202 Accepted with minimal/no content via bot detection. Direct HTTP also returns 202.

crawl4ai_results.label: stein-X
crawl4ai_results.content_quality: X.COM LIMITATIONS - Page loaded but markdown extraction was empty (JS-rendered timeline)
crawl4ai_results.verdict: LIMITED - X.com pages are JS-heavy; crawl4ai can fetch links but content extraction requires JS rendering. Better to use Nitter RSS if available.
crawl4ai_results.issues: X.com blocks direct HTTP (TLS reset). crawl4ai loads page but markdown is empty. Links extracted include X profile links only, not tweet content.

crawl4ai_results.label: macmahon-X
crawl4ai_results.content_quality: X.COM LIMITATIONS - Same as other X profiles
crawl4ai_results.issues: Direct HTTP: ECONNRESET. crawl4ai: 200 but empty markdown.

crawl4ai_results.label: townsend-X
crawl4ai_results.content_quality: X.COM LIMITATIONS - External links found include dallasnews.com articles
crawl4ai_results.verdict: LIMITED - But external links include articles from dallasnews.com (e.g., mark-cuban-patrick-dumont-mavericks-ownership-22367536.php). These can be followed.
crawl4ai_results.issues: Direct HTTP: ECONNRESET. External links sample: dallasnews.com article URLs.

crawl4ai_results.label: dallasnews
crawl4ai_results.content_quality: EXCELLENT - Rich article listing, headlines, and links visible in markdown
crawl4ai_results.verdict: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED - Best non-official source. Local Dallas coverage, 108 article links detected in HTML. Soft paywall but article listings are free.
crawl4ai_results.issues: Soft paywall may limit full article content for some pieces. Article headlines/links are accessible.

crawl4ai_results.label: si-mavs
crawl4ai_results.content_quality: MARKDOWN EMPTY - Page loaded but markdown extraction returned empty string. Internal links are mostly nav.
crawl4ai_results.verdict: NOT RECOMMENDED - Markdown extraction failed (JS-heavy page). Direct HTTP gets 702KB HTML but article extraction from raw HTML would need custom parsing.
crawl4ai_results.issues: markdown extraction returned empty despite 200 status and 702KB HTML. Likely a JS-rendered SPA.

crawl4ai_results.label: cbs-mavs
crawl4ai_results.content_quality: MARKDOWN EMPTY - Markdown extraction returned empty
crawl4ai_results.verdict: NOT RECOMMENDED - Direct HTTP returns 406 (Not Acceptable). crawl4ai can fetch page (200, 361 int links) but markdown is empty. CBS heavily blocks automation.
crawl4ai_results.issues: Direct HTTP returns 406. crawl4ai: 200 status but empty markdown. Anti-bot measures.

crawl4ai_results.label: yahoo-mavs
crawl4ai_results.content_quality: GOOD - Article content visible. Found article links including recent Naji Marshall extension story.
crawl4ai_results.verdict: RECOMMENDED - Yahoo Sports is reachable and provides article content. Found a specific Mavs article about Marshall contract extension.
crawl4ai_results.issues: Direct HTTP returns 403, but crawl4ai successfully fetches and extracts content. Only 2 article links in markdown suggests mostly navigation in the extracted content.

crawl4ai_results.label: athletic-mavs
crawl4ai_results.content_quality: MARKDOWN EMPTY + HARD PAYWALL - Page loaded but markdown extraction returned empty
crawl4ai_results.verdict: NOT RECOMMENDED - Hard paywall. Direct HTTP times out. crawl4ai gets 200 but no markdown. Athletic content requires subscription.
crawl4ai_results.issues: Direct HTTP: ETIMEDOUT to NYT server. Hard paywall prevents content access.

crawl4ai_results.label: bleacher-mavs
crawl4ai_results.content_quality: PAGE LOADED - 109KB of markdown but it's mostly site navigation and layout. No article links in markdown despite external links to Mavs blog posts.
crawl4ai_results.verdict: PARTIALLY USEFUL - High link count (77 external). External links include Mavs content from thesmokingcuban.com and mavsmoneyball.com. Useful as a link discovery source.
crawl4ai_results.issues: Direct HTTP returns 403. Markdown extracts site chrome, not article content. External links can be harvested to find blog posts.

recommended_whitelist.description: URLs recommended for the white-list architecture. Ordered by priority.

priority_order.label: NBA.com Mavs News
priority_order.reasoning: Official source. crawl4ai extracts 27KB markdown with 11 article links. 200 OK via both crawl4ai and direct HTTP.

priority_order.label: Dallas Morning News Mavs
priority_order.reasoning: Best non-official source. 57KB markdown with 84 article links! Local coverage by Townsend, Caplan, Curtis. 200 OK on direct HTTP.

priority_order.label: Yahoo Sports Mavs
priority_order.reasoning: 78KB markdown, reachable via crawl4ai. Direct HTTP blocked (403) but crawl4ai works. Found current Mavs articles.

priority_order.label: Bleacher Report Mavs
priority_order.reasoning: 109KB markdown, 77 external links pointing to Mavs blog content. Useful for link discovery even if main content is navigation. Direct HTTP blocked (403) but crawl4ai works.

priority_order.label: Mavs Moneyball (SB Nation)
priority_order.reasoning: Active fan community blog. Frequently referenced from Bleacher Report external links.

priority_order.label: Marc Stein X
priority_order.reasoning: Top Mavs journalist. crawl4ai can fetch links (42 int, 4 ext) but markdown content is empty due to JS rendering. Consider using Nitter RSS or dedicated X API.

priority_order.label: Marc Stein Substack
priority_order.reasoning: Alternative to X feed. Substack is generally more scraper-friendly.

not_recommended.reason: Bot detection returns 202 with empty/minimal content. ESPN actively blocks scraping.
Markdown extraction returns empty despite 200 status. JS-heavy SPA layout.
Direct HTTP returns 406. crawl4ai returns empty markdown. Heavy anti-bot measures.
Hard paywall. Direct HTTP times out to NYT CDN. crawl4ai gets 200 but empty markdown.
301 redirect to nba.com/mavs/news. Use destination URL directly.

x_com_strategy.description: X.com (Twitter) profiles are JS-heavy and block direct HTTP access. crawl4ai can fetch page structure (links) but cannot extract tweet content as markdown.
x_com_strategy.recommendation: For X/Twitter journalist monitoring, consider: (1) Nitter instances for RSS/HTML access; (2) X API v2 (paid) for tweet timeline; (3) RSS bridges like rss-bridge or nitter.net RSS feeds. crawl4ai is insufficient for X.com content extraction.

response_structure.note: Response contains 'results' array with page-level data including: url, html, markdown, cleaned_html, links (internal/external arrays), metadata, status_code, redirected_url, screenshot, extracted_content
response_structure.markdown_key: results[].markdown - contains raw_markdown object with 'raw_markdown', 'markdown_with_citations', 'references_markdown', 'fit_markdown' keys
